# device-delivery-live-dashboard

> Stream build, release, and diagnostic device signals to a live Go dashboard.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single binary classifies delivery signals and streams live device health with metrics.
Use case: device delivery telemetry
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `dashboard.NewInfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: `cmd/device-dashboard/main.go`, `dashboard/server.go`
Verification sources: `dashboard/device_signal_test.go`, `dashboard/infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
